'''Arcon Multinode Agricorp''', commonly referred to simply as '''Arcon Multinode''',<ref name="HSSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref> was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]-owned major macro [[Farm/Legends|farming]] and food processing corporation during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="HSCS" />

Arcon was amongst the original group of [[contributing sponsor]]s who invested in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], and were upgraded to [[voting sponsor]]. This meant that the company received discounted rates on goods that were sourced within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], although Arcon also had significant holdings in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where they bought over thirty percent of crops grown by independent [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]. It also owned [[Flangth-2-Go]], the second largest fast food chain in the Empire.<ref name="HSCS" />

[[File:Arcon_Multinode_Hybrid_Plantings_TEGTPM.jpg|250px|thumb|Arcon Multinode hybrid plantings on [[Taanab]]]]
[[Arcon Multinode Hybrid Plantings|A series of hybrid plantings]] were established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]] by the company, located near to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pandath/Legends|Pandath]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
